name: The Dudez!!!1!

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/uspw-65-and-older/archive/month-2007-01-p1-40.html.

caption: The tag team of Trent Shaffer and Frankie Perez, which Shaffer rebuilds with Mainstream Hernandez to win the World Tag Team Championship. In October 2007 they save Sam Strong from the Hotshots and beat the Hotshots at A Haunting in America. In October and November 2007 they trade insults with The Best Tag Team Like Ever in a pick-your-poison series (each side picks the other's opponent: Perez loses to Human Arsenal, Bruce the Giant beats Chance Fortune), lose a tag warm-up on the Family Night of Thursday, Week 2, and win the I Quit Match at Pilgrimage when Perez locks the P-Clutch on Trent Shaffer and Shaffer says he quits. In late November and December 2007 they are chased by Veteran Mentality, lose to The Hotshots by count-out, win a non-title cage match in 14:38 by getting away from Force and Oxford with a cry of 'Look! Godzilla!', and are booked against Veteran Mentality at Winter Epiphany.

name: Maxmillion Productions

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/uspw-65-and-older/archive/month-2007-01-p1-40.html.

caption: Zeus Maxmillion's film company, whose stars Rudy Velasquez and T-Rex also fight as a team. In October 2007 Zeus Maxmillion, Rudy Velasquez and T-Rex offer their services to Divinity, are given a match, and are then beaten by Triple D, Fumihiro Ota and Human Arsenal and told to stay away. In October and November 2007 Zeus Maxmillion and Rudy Velasquez lose a #1 contendership match to The Valentines when Fumihiro Ota kicks Casey Valentine, lose to Team Seduction in a match the narrator rates a B+, and are left with nothing to do, the narrator says, though fans like Maxmillion and dislike Velasquez, who gets a new look. Devine hires them in November 2007 to find the Masked Man; they tell him it is Wolf Hawkins, Devine turns on them and crushes T-Rex under a vending machine when it proves wrong, and they are booked against The Hotshots at Winter Epiphany.

name: Veteran Mentality

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/uspw-65-and-older/archive/month-2007-04-p83-116.html.

caption: The tag team of Jim Force and Robert Oxford, first billed under a working title the narrator calls a placeholder; they beat The Towers of Power, Savage Fury and Maxmillion Productions and lose a World Tag Team Championship match to The Dudez!!!1! in April 2007. In October 2007, with the foul-mouthed parrot Mr. Pizzles in a cage beside them, they lose to Team Seduction on the Thursday of Week 1 (with Steve Flash), on the Monday of Week 2 (with Wanda Fish) and in the World Tag Team Championship match at A Haunting in America, and Force holds a funeral for a dead pigeon, Mr. Squiggles. In November 2007, after The Hotshots are given only community service for the murder of the pigeon Mr. Squiggles, Jim Force breaks down, beats them bloody on the Family Night of Thursday, Week 2, and he and Robert Oxford beat them at Pilgrimage; on the Monday of Week 3 Force looses the white tiger Mr. Snuggleforce on them. Force and Oxford lose to The Hotshots on the Thursday of Week 4, November 2007, chase The Dudez!!!1!!! through the halls and onto a beach for several shows and are booked against them at Winter Epiphany.

name: The Hotshots

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/uspw-65-and-older/archive/month-2007-05-p116-130.html.

caption: The tag team of Davis Wayne Newton and Cameron Vessey, beaten in May 2007 by Wanda Fish and Giant Oak and by Bulldozer Brandon Smith and Trent Shaffer. In October 2007 they work as Triple D's apprentices: they beat down Sam Strong, lose to The Dudez!!!1! at A Haunting in America, and are arrested on the Thursday of Week 3 for the "murder" of a pigeon. In October and November 2007 they are jailed for the murder of the pigeon Mr. Squiggles, found guilty and sentenced to 20 hours of community service, beaten bloody by Veteran Mentality, lose to them at Pilgrimage, are made members of Divinity there, win the World Tag Team Championship from The Valentines in 1:56 and keep it against them on the Monday of Week 3. In November and December 2007 they sit through community service as substitute teachers and in a nursing home, are chased by Jim Force and Mr. Snuggleforce, beat Veteran Mentality and Pure Evil, win a count-out over The Dudez!!!1!!!, lose a non-title cage match to them, and are told by Devine to win at Winter Epiphany.

name: The dudes

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/uspw-65-and-older/archive/month-2007-07-p193-240.html.

caption: The pairing of Trent Shaffer and his partner Chance Fortune, whom the narrator has not yet named: billed only as the dudes, they challenge The Dudez!!!1! for the World Tag Team Championship in July and August 2007 and lose both matches. As The Best Tag Team Like Ever, or TBTTLE, they lose again to The Valentines at A Haunting in America in October 2007, and Shaffer and Chance Fortune challenge The Dudez!!!1! to a match at Pilgrimage. In October and November 2007 they trade insults with The Dudez!!!1! in a pick-your-poison series, beat them in a tag warm-up on the Family Night of Thursday, Week 2, and lose the I Quit Match at Pilgrimage when Trent Shaffer says he quits under Frankie Perez's P-Clutch.

aka: The Best Tag Team Like Ever

name: Team Seduction

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/uspw-65-and-older/archive/month-2007-07-p193-240.html.

caption: The group Seduction gathers in July 2007 to end Darryl Devine's career: Human Arsenal and Fumihiro Ota, joined by his former friend Jacob Jett; William Hayes, offered a place, turns on them. Arsenal and Ota, as Team Seduction, beat The Dudez!!!1! at Summer of Love in August 2007 to win the World Tag Team Championship. Arsenal and Ota keep the belts from The Dudez!!!1! in a ladder match at Blaze of Glory in September 2007, and the group with Triple D, Jett and Big Cat Brandon goes on as Divinity. In October 2007 Arsenal drops Sam Strong through his own desk with a C4 Suplex, and the team beats Veteran Mentality three times, the last at A Haunting in America. In November 2007 Arsenal and Ota side with Seduction against Triple D, who leaves her tied to a chair in the Masked Man's video to finish a match; they lose the tag belts to The Valentines at Pilgrimage when Devine turns on Arsenal, and Arsenal takes Devine to over twenty minutes on the Monday of Week 3. Arsenal and Ota lose to Umaga and Freddie Datsun on the Thursday of Week 3, November 2007 and beat The Best Tag Team Like Ever on the Monday of Week 4; the group takes Devine on after he injures Arsenal, and the author calls Arsenal's 26:35 loss to Devine on the Thursday of Week 2, December the new best match in USPW history.

name: The Valentines

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/uspw-65-and-older/archive/month-2007-09-p310-344.html.

caption: The uncle and nephew Peter and Casey Valentine, who face The Best Tag Team Like Ever (Trent Shaffer and Chance Fortune) at Blaze of Glory in September 2007 and win by count-out when Peter, who has begged Shaffer off, hugs the referee. They beat The Best Tag Team Like Ever again at A Haunting in America in October 2007, while Peter keeps calling Casey his son. They become the #1 contenders on the Family Night of Thursday, Week 4, October 2007 when Fumihiro Ota costs Maxmillion Productions the match by disqualification, win the World Tag Team Championship from Team Seduction at Pilgrimage when Triple D turns on Arsenal, and lose it minutes later to The Hotshots. In late November and December 2007 Peter keeps insisting Casey is his son, Casey punches him and finally asks Jillefski for a match with him, and Peter wins in 4:43 by roll-up while refusing to fight back.

name: Divinity

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/uspw-65-and-older/archive/ppv-blaze-of-glory-part-two-p352-362.html.

caption: The stable Triple D announces on the Monday of Week 3, September 2007, after Blaze of Glory, with Seduction, Danny Jillefski, Human Arsenal, Fumihiro Ota, Big Cat Brandon and Jacob Jett ("One word, survival"), to take over USPW; Art Reed signs with Seduction on the Monday of Week 4, and The Hotshots come to Devine as apprentices who are not yet members. A reader calls it Team Seduction renamed. In October 2007 Triple D calls the group to a meeting from which Seduction, Jacob Jett, Art Reed, Human Arsenal and Fumihiro Ota walk out; its members attack Muffin and Sam Strong and turn on Maxmillion Productions. In October 2007 Triple D announces Akima as the group's newest member after Akima kicks Umaga; on Thursday, Week 1, November Seduction, Human Arsenal and Fumihiro Ota turn against Devine, who calls a meeting on the Family Night of Week 2 ("who is with Divinity?") and is told at Pilgrimage that he is not its leader; at Pilgrimage Danny Jillefski makes The Hotshots its newest members, and Jillefski, who has taken over USPW, opens the Monday of Week 3 with the group around him. From the Family Night of Thursday, Week 3, November 2007 to the Monday of Week 4, December 2007 the group tears itself apart: Devine strikes Seduction for saying she leads it and slams a door on Human Arsenal's forearm, Arsenal, Ota and The Hotshots beat Devine down in the hall, Arsenal quits and is talked back in, Devine pays Maxmillion Productions to unmask the Masked Man and puts Wolf Hawkins in the ring in a bag, and by the Monday of Week 4 Devine gives Seduction a week to choose between him and the grave.

name: The Wild Savages

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/uspw-65-and-older/archive/month-2007-09-p363-402.html.

caption: Jacob Stranton's two Samoans, Umaga and Akima, whom he bills as a destructive force that will take the tag belts from Team Seduction or the World Championship from Triple D; they beat Pure Evil on the Family Night of Thursday, Week 3, September 2007 and Akima beats Bruce the Giant on the Monday of Week 3. In October 2007 they attack Bruce the Giant at the food table week after week, lose to Muffin and Freddie Datsun, beat Sam Strong down on the Thursday of Week 2, and lose to Bruce the Giant and their brother Giant Tana at A Haunting in America. In October 2007 Jacob Stranton leads Akima and Umaga to the ring to join Divinity, which turns out to be a trap: Akima kicks Umaga and is welcomed in his place. In November Umaga loses a World Championship match to Triple D, Stranton is put into intensive care by Eddie Peak, and Umaga beats Akima at Pilgrimage.

In late November 2007 Joss Thompson takes Archnemesis and Evil Machine (the former Insane Machine) as his 'associates'; they jump The Hotshots and lose to them on the Monday of Week 1, December.
